items.text: The career ladder runs operations executive → operations/marketplace manager (3-5 years) → category or supply chain lead (5-8 years) → head of operations (8-12+ years).
One suspended account can freeze revenue overnight.
Here are the six functions that make up most real e-commerce operations work in India, what each one involves day to day, and who tends to fit each one.
They are ordered by real growth headroom, not by which one is easiest to get hired into first.
At the more senior end, you own a product category end to end, vendor negotiations, pricing strategy, margin targets, and demand planning for that category across channels.
